record.reason: HEAL-Summ is a longitudinal health-news summarization and ethics/evaluation pipeline using Phi-3, Qwen 2.5 and Llama 3.2. It processes a 30k+ article corpus and emphasizes local/on-device low-cost deployment; evaluation focuses on semantic similarity, readability, diversity, tone and toxicity. It does not introduce or benchmark a model compression, inference-kernel, throughput or latency improvement; its connection is deployment of small LLMs in an application, so borderline.
record.title: HEAL-Summ: a lightweight and ethical framework for accessible summarization of health information
